component.name: frlg-native
component.summary: Play a cartridge you own, natively

description.p: A native source port rather than an emulator: the game's own code is recompiled for the host, so it runs as a normal application instead of being interpreted as machine code for another processor.
No game data is included. The launcher imports it from a cartridge image you already own, verifies it, and keeps a prepared copy so the original is not needed again.
